text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... just want to catch up to my friend...
That's the
only goal I have...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if nobody else can see my
friend...
because they are right beside
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
